title: Black hole and host galaxy growth in an isolated z ∼ 6 QSO observed with ALMA
question: To trace the evolutionary paths of the z~6 QSO J2310+1855 and its host galaxy by comparing its star formation rate (from dust SED) with its black hole accretion rate, and studying its cold gas kinematics, outflows, water vapour emission, and environment.

recipe.goal: Measure continuum flux densities and source sizes across ALMA bands
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fitting in CASA on natural-weighted continuum maps, and integrating flux over >2 sigma region for Dataset I. Re-imaged and fitted 10 archival ALMA continuum datasets.
key_parameters: >2 sigma region integration threshold; natural weighting for all SED continuum points
assumptions: Dataset II (lower resolution) recovers the total 265 GHz flux density, whereas Dataset I filters out ~25-30% of extended flux; Dataset II is therefore used for the SED fit.

recipe.goal: Extract [CII] and H2O moment maps, line profiles, fluxes, and sizes
recipe.method: Created moment-0, -1, and -2 maps from the Briggs cube (for [CII], with a 3 sigma threshold) and natural cube (for H2O). Extracted spectra from the >2 sigma region in the velocity-integrated map, fitted line profiles with single and double Gaussians, and fitted 2D Gaussians to moment-0 maps for sizes.
key_parameters: 3 sigma threshold for [CII] moment maps; >2 sigma velocity-integrated map region for spectral extraction

recipe.goal: Fit mm-to-FIR dust SED and derive dust properties, TIR luminosity, SFR, and GDR
recipe.method: Fitted ALMA and Herschel continuum flux densities with a modified black-body (MBB) function alone and combined with SKIRTOR AGN dusty torus templates. Integrated best-fit models from 8 to 1000 um rest-frame to get L_TIR, and derived SFR and GDR.
key_parameters: Free parameters: 20 K <= T_dust <= 300 K, 6 <= log(M_dust/M_sun) <= 10, 1 <= beta <= 2, and torus normalisation 10^-5 <= a <= 1.
assumptions: Mass absorption coefficient k_0 = 0.45 cm^2 g^-1 at 250 GHz; T_CMB(z=0) = 2.73 K; solid angle estimated from mean continuum emission size of ALMA observations in Table 3.
50% of L_TIR (MBB) is heated by the QSO (Duras et al. 2017); Chabrier IMF for SFR; M(H2) = (4.4 +/- 0.2) x 10^10 M_sun with alpha_CO = 0.8 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 for GDR.

recipe.goal: Compute radial surface brightness profiles, half-light radii, neutral gas mass, and gas surface density
recipe.method: Extracted azimuthally averaged surface brightness profiles in concentric annuli centred on the QSO continuum peak from natural-weighted maps of [CII], dust continuum, and CO(6-5), subtracting background rms per annulus. Computed M_HI from L_[CII] using the PDR relation.
key_parameters: Annulus thickness: 0.1 arcsec for [CII] and dust continuum, 0.25 arcsec for CO(6-5); background rms area: 10 x 20 arcsec^2
assumptions: For M_HI: n >> n_crit (n_crit ~ 3 x 10^3 cm^-3), C+ abundance X_C+ ~ 10^-4, gas temperature T = 200 K.

recipe.goal: Model 3D [CII] disk kinematics, derive dynamical mass, and compute Toomre Q_gas profile
recipe.method: Fitted a 3D tilted-ring model to the [CII] data cube using 3DBarolo, excluding the central beam to avoid nuclear systematics/beam smearing, and explored the v_rot - i parameter space with SPACEVAR. Derived M_dyn within r = 1.7 kpc and calculated the radial Toomre parameter Q_gas.
key_parameters: Centre fixed to continuum peak; PA = 200 deg; inclination i = 25 deg (from initial free run, explored [20, 45] deg); initial guesses v_rot = 50 km/s, sigma_gas = 70 km/s; 5 rings spaced by 0.045 arcsec starting at 0.113 arcsec (excluding central 0.08 arcsec).
assumptions: Flat rotation curve for Q_gas calculation; inclinations i > 30 deg ruled out because M_dyn must exceed M_H2 = 4.2 x 10^10 M_sun; inclinations i < 20 deg ruled out due to unreasonably high v_rot.

recipe.goal: Characterize the [CII] high-velocity outflow and its energetics
recipe.method: Collapsed spectral channels of the red and blue [CII] wings to map their spatial distribution, subtracted the double-Gaussian disk fit from the 1D spectrum to measure wing fluxes, and computed outflow mass, mass outflow rate, kinetic power, and momentum load.
key_parameters: v_out,blue = -490 km/s, v_out,red = 535 km/s (98% integrated wing flux velocity); R_out,blue = 0.6 kpc, R_out,red = 0.3 kpc (or R_out ~ 1 kpc clean beam for lower limit).
assumptions: Time-averaged expelled shells or clumps geometry (Rupke et al. 2005); PDR parameters T = 200 K, X_C+ = 10^-4, n >> n_crit; L_bol = 3.13 x 10^47 erg s^-1.

recipe.goal: Search for companion line/continuum emitters and constrain Serenity-18
recipe.method: Scanned all four spectral windows for line emitters, imaged continuum with a 0.5 arcsec uvtaper to detect faint continuum structure, and placed 3 sigma upper limits on 265 GHz continuum and [CII] emission at the position of Serenity-18.
key_parameters: Line scan threshold: S/N > 3 per spectral channel over at least 20 adjacent channels (Delta v >= 150 km/s); uvtaper = 0.5 arcsec for continuum search.
assumptions: For Serenity-18 upper limits: T_dust = 40 K, beta = 1.5, source size equal to clean beam, [CII] line width = 200 km/s, and SFR - L_[CII] relations from Carniani et al. (2018) and Herrera-Camus et al. (2018).
